text:
Type: turquoise tabletop picture frame
Use: displaying a photo or print on a shelf, a desk or a wall; living room, home office, bedroom
Style: contemporary, retro, Scandinavian
Materials: smooth molded plastic frame in a soft satin finish, clear front panel, black fiberboard back with a fold-out stand
Colors: light turquoise, aqua blue, black back
Shape: slim rectangular portrait frame with a flat, fairly wide border and softly rounded edges, small and lightweight
Feel: cheerful, fresh, playful
Goes with: white walls, light wood shelves, pastel or bright accents; Scandinavian, retro or casual rooms

product.name: FISKBO
product.description: Can be used hanging or standing, both horizontally and vertically, to fit in the space available.
